summary: Frontend-only review of Burger & Grill Camucia overhaul. Tested at 390/1024/1280/1440 viewports. All functional items from the review request pass except for 2 minor items (zip 404 not a true 404 - SPA fallback; a React console warning for empty-string `inert` attribute).

action_items: LOW: Fix React warning about `inert` empty string — pass `inert={isHidden ? true : undefined}` or `{...(isHidden && {inert: ''})}` to suppress the console warning in MobileMenu / AccordionSection (and anywhere else inert is used).

OPTIONAL: Make /burger-grill-source.zip return a real 404 (currently returns 200 HTML via CRA SPA fallback). Not a security risk since the actual zip was removed, but the request specifically asks for 404. In production (hosted static build served by Nginx/CDN) this will naturally return 404 — in CRA dev-server it serves index.html for unknown paths.

DEFER (documented in request): Full focus-trap/restore via Radix Dialog in CartDrawer is NOT applied this round. Current drawer uses role=dialog aria-modal + aria-labelledby but no focus trap. Flag as 'defer / documented'.
critical_code_review_comments: Reviews.jsx keeps dead code for carousel/stars that is only reached when source==='google'. Since billing is disabled this path is unreachable; consider gating by Feature flag or removing unused branches to reduce surface.
AccordionSection and MobileMenu using `inert` with React — React treats empty-string booleans as false; current implementation triggers a dev warning. Low-risk but noisy.

App returns the ZIP path via SPA fallback as HTML 200 — relying on prod CDN for a real 404. If someone deploys the dev build or a mis-configured server, same path could leak. Explicit 404 route or Nginx block would be safer.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (26/26 functional items pass; 1 console warning; 1 minor zip 404 note)
